title: Add Generateur d'image ia to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Generateur d'image ia](https://mzaacdepy.github.io/generateur-images-ia) to image
- Generate images with the French-language AI image generator web app built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.

Fixes #11230

gist.headline: Une nouvelle fleur française
gist.blurb: Generateur d'image ia has joined the garden: a French-language image generator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Proof that a small static site can still grow some very large pixels.
gist.summary: Added Generateur d'image ia to the app catalog, a French-language AI image generator web app built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
gist.impact: French-speaking makers can now discover and use another community-built image-generation app in the Pollinations ecosystem.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming a small French-inspired image-generator kiosk into a blooming code garden: a retro monitor displays a cheerful generated landscape, with a tiny tricolor pennant and French pixel text. The scene represents a lightweight vanilla-web app joining the wider Pollinations image garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny artist beret, welcoming a retro image-generator computer kiosk into a blooming code garden. The monitor glows lime green (#ecf874) and shows a generated pastel landscape, with a small French tricolor pennant and pixel-font text "GÉNÉRATEUR D'IMAGE"; code-plants and soft flowers grow around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, like Stardew Valley, nostalgic but beautiful.
